local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.name: Hugging Face models
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.line: AI models you downloaded from Hugging Face
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.what: AI models for text, images or speech that programs downloaded from Hugging Face, one folder per model.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.made: Programs that use Hugging Face, such as Python scripts and local AI apps.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.if-r: A program that needs the model downloads it again; until then, links to its files stop working.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-models.come: Yes, by download when a program asks for it, which can take long; a private model also needs your Hugging Face login.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.li: Datasets you downloaded from Hugging Face
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.wh: Data that programs downloaded from Hugging Face to train or test AI models, one folder per dataset.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.ma: Programs that use Hugging Face, such as Python scripts and training tools.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.if: A program that needs the dataset downloads it again; until then, links to its files stop working.
local-ai-models.hugging-face-datasets.co: Yes, by download when a program asks for it, which can take long; a private dataset also needs your Hugging Face login.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.name: LM Studio models
local-ai-models.lm-studio.line: Models you downloaded in LM Studio
local-ai-models.lm-studio.what: The models LM Studio keeps to run on this Mac, one folder per model.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.made-by: LM Studio, an app that runs AI models on your Mac.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.if-removed: LM Studio no longer lists the model. Your chats and LM Studio's settings stay.
local-ai-models.lm-studio.comes-back: If you downloaded it in LM Studio, yes: download it there again; a model you added yourself comes back only from your own copy.
local-ai-models.ollama.name: Ollama models
local-ai-models.ollama.what: The AI models Ollama keeps to run on this Mac; models can share files.
local-ai-models.ollama.made-by: Ollama, an app that runs AI models on your Mac.
local-ai-models.ollama.if-removed: Ollama no longer lists the model. Files another model uses stay, so your other models keep working.
local-ai-models.ollama.comes-back: Yes, `ollama pull` with its name downloads it again; a model you made yourself comes back only from your own files.
local-ai-models.enabled.label: Local AI models
local-ai-models.enabled.description: Finds models downloaded by Hugging Face, LM Studio and Ollama. Each one goes to the Trash; most come back by download.
local-ai-models.title: {name}
local-ai-models.reason.hugging-face: Downloaded from Hugging Face; last opened or changed on {date}. A program that needs it downloads {size} again.
local-ai-models.reason.lm-studio: Kept by LM Studio; last opened or changed on {date}. Downloading it again in LM Studio takes {size}; a model you added yourself does not come back.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. `ollama pull {name}` downloads its {size} again; a model you made yourself does not come back that way.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama-shared: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and stays.
local-ai-models.reason.ollama-shared-mor: Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and {count} more model and stays.
Kept by Ollama; last opened or changed on {date}. It is {listed} in all, of which {size} is freed; the rest is shared with {other} and {count} more models and stays.
local-ai-models.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to macOS or another user, or is locked, so only an administrator can remove it.
local-ai-models.left-out.special: A running program may be using it, so it is kept.
local-ai-models.left-out.app-open: LM Studio is open and may be using its models. Quit it and scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps this. Scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-unreadab: One of Ollama's model lists could not be read, so Fresher cannot tell which files its models share. Nothing of Ollama is offered.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-download: Ollama is downloading a model, or a download was left unfinished. Let it finish, then scan again.
local-ai-models.left-out.ollama-incomple: Some of this model's files are missing or still being written. Pulling it again in Ollama repairs it.
